newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Rabies kills 12 people in Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: Rabies kills 12 people in Sierra Leone.

text.p: Rabies has killed 12 people in Sierra Leone's second town of Bo and at least 40 are in hospital with the disease after being bitten by stray dogs, health officials said on Wednesday.

A government veterinary officer in the town said by telephone that the number of dogs in the southern town had increased dramatically since traditional hunters had started clearing rebels from surrounding villages.
The number of reported cases of dog bites had increased 10-fold, he added.

Sierra Leone's government and the rebels have agreed a fragile truce but talks on a lasting peace have been stalled for months. Despite frequent breaches of the truce, neither side has spoken of a return to all-out fighting.
The rebels took up arms in 1991.
